summary: Hardware diagnostic research profile. Candidate features: jog,motor,pad,fader,eq,audio,usb. Software: DJUCED,Serato DJ Lite.
identityNotes: Research seed; DJControl Inpulse T7 output routing and USB Audio/MIDI transport are manufacturer-documented. USB input-channel count, USB identifiers, class compliance, firmware/OS compatibility and physical performance remain unverified; no factory tolerances or control mappings are claimed.

documents.title: DJControl Inpulse T7 English user manual
documents.notes: Checked 2026-11-18. Printed pages 8, 41–42, 48–49 and 75 document output routing, connectors and USB transport. No document revision or publication date identified; screenshot firmware versions are not qualification baselines.

tests.title: Jog movement, touch and direction
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check DJControl Inpulse T7 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all jog controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed

tests.title: Firmware and software compatibility
steps: Inspect device model and installed firmware.
Check exact model's official support page for updates and compatible software.
Record version, OS, source and date.

tests.title: Motorized platter RPM selection
steps: Run 33⅓ RPM mode using the supported DJ software.
Observe physical platter behavior, note noise or slip and check touch detection.
If Serato DJ Pro is available, select 45 RPM and verify expected change; no DeckChek accuracy calibration is implied.

tests.title: Effects paddle, stems and mode response
steps: Test each deck's FX selection and paddle engage/disengage.
Test stems controls in supported application.
Check each pad mode and verify LEDs and control response.
